1.label: ТЕКСТ
1.title: Caladan
1.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
1.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
1.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
1.text:
Caladan is a world of oceans and endless rain, and House Atreides has ruled it for twenty generations. Paul Atreides, the Duke's only son, is fifteen. Every night he has the same dream: a burning desert, a yellow sun and a girl with deep blue eyes. He doesn't understand it, but he remembers every detail.

By day, Paul is studying a planet that no one has officially mentioned to him: Arrakis, also known as Dune. He knows that it is the only source of the spice, the most valuable substance in the universe. He suspects that his father is hiding something.

This morning the castle seems unusually busy. Servants are packing, soldiers are cleaning their weapons, and his mother is watching him more closely than usual.

words.d: a material of a particular kind
think something is true without proof
all people born at about the same time

options: A desert and a girl with blue eyes
It is the only source of the spice

items.q: What is happening in the castle this morning?
Which sentence uses a stative verb correctly?
Which sentence describes an action happening now?

2.label: ТЕКСТ
2.title: The Herald
2.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
2.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
2.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
2.text:
The Emperor's herald arrived while the court was assembling in the great hall. Trumpets were playing, and the Duke was standing beside his throne. In a loud voice, the herald announced that House Atreides would now rule Arrakis.

While the courtiers were applauding, Paul noticed that his father did not smile. For eighty years the planet had belonged to the Harkonnens, the oldest enemies of the Atreides. They were giving it up suspiciously easily.

Later that evening, Paul found his father alone on the balcony. The rain was falling, and the Duke was staring at the sea. 'It's a trap, isn't it?' Paul asked. 'Yes,' Leto answered. 'But it is also an opportunity. And the Emperor knew I couldn't refuse.'

words.d: a person who carries official messages
a person who attends a royal court
in a way that makes you distrust something

items.q: What does Leto call the offer?

options: a person who carries official messages

items.q: Which sentence shows a background action interrupted?
options: The herald was arriving while the court assembled yesterday always.
The herald arrived while the court was assembling.
The herald arrives while the court assembled.

items.q: Which sentence describes a finished past action?
options: The herald was announce the news.

3.label: ТЕКСТ
3.title: The Test
3.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
3.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
3.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
3.text:
Reverend Mother Mohiam has travelled across the galaxy to test Paul. She has never tested a boy before. She orders him to put his hand into a small black box, while she holds a poisoned needle, the gom jabbar, against his neck.

'If you pull your hand out, you die,' she says. The pain is unbearable; Paul has never felt anything like it. He feels his skin burning, but he remembers the litany his mother taught him: 'Fear is the mind-killer.'

When it is over, Paul looks at his hand. There is no injury at all. The pain was an illusion. The Reverend Mother has seen many candidates fail, but this boy has passed. She leaves the room thoughtfully, and Jessica, who waited outside, finally starts breathing again.

words.d: something that seems real but is not
a person being tested or chosen

items.q: What does the Reverend Mother hold at Paul's neck?
What helps Paul endure the pain?
What does Paul find when he looks at his hand?

options: something that seems real but is not

options: She never tested a boy before now ever.
She has never tested a boy before.
She has never test a boy.

items.q: Which sentence uses the past simple correctly?
options: The pain has been an illusion yesterday.
The pain is being an illusion.

4.label: ТЕКСТ
4.title: Giedi Prime
4.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
4.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
4.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
4.text:
On the black planet of Giedi Prime, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen is floating above the floor on suspensors, smiling. 'We're giving Arrakis to the Atreides,' he tells his nephew Rabban, 'but only for a while.'

His adviser Piter explains the plan. The Duke is going to arrive with his family and his finest soldiers. The Emperor will secretly send his terrifying Sardaukar troops to help the Harkonnens. And someone inside the Duke's household will betray him.

'When is the attack?' Rabban asks impatiently. 'We're meeting the Sardaukar commander next month,' Piter replies. 'The Duke will be dead within a year.' The Baron laughs softly. He has waited eighty years for this. He can wait a little longer.

words.d: a device that makes things float
be disloyal to someone who trusts you

items.q: Who will secretly help the Harkonnens?
Which sentence describes a fixed arrangement?
options: We meet the commander next month maybe.
We're meeting the commander next month.
We met the commander next month.
The Duke is dead within a year.
The Duke was dead within a year.
The Duke will be dead within a year.

5.label: ТЕКСТ
5.title: Farewell
5.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
5.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
5.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
5.text:
It is the last day on Caladan. The Atreides soldiers stand in rows in front of the largest ships Paul has ever seen. The pipers play the oldest and saddest tune of the house.

Gurney Halleck tells Paul that Arrakis is the hottest, driest and most dangerous planet in the empire. 'It's far worse than anything you've imagined,' he says. 'The sand is more dangerous than any army.'

Paul walks to the edge of the cliff and looks at the ocean for the last time. Caladan has never seemed more beautiful. Behind him, the biggest Guild ship of all is waiting to swallow the entire house. His mother puts a hand on his shoulder. 'The harder the place,' she says quietly, 'the stronger the people it makes.'

items.q: What does Paul look at for the last time?

options: The harder the place, the stronger the people.
Harder the place, stronger the people.
The hard the place, the strong the people.

7.label: ТЕКСТ
7.title: Arrakeen
7.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
7.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
7.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
7.text:
The ships land in Arrakeen, and the heat hits them like a wall. Thufir Hawat gathers the household at once. 'You must drink whenever you can,' he says. 'You mustn't go outside at midday, and you have to wear a stillsuit if you leave the city.'

The palace that the Harkonnens left behind is gloomy and full of hidden dangers. Every room has to be checked for poison and listening devices. 'Do we have to check the kitchens too?' a young soldier asks. 'Especially the kitchens,' Thufir replies.

Outside, a crowd of locals is shouting strange words at Lady Jessica: 'Mahdi! Lisan al-Gaib!' She doesn't have to understand the language to know that they are expecting something from her son.

words.d: a machine or tool for a purpose
a suit that saves the body's water

items.q: What must people never do at midday?
What has to be checked in every room?

options: You must go outside at midday.
You don't have to go outside at midday.
You mustn't go outside at midday.

items.q: Which sentence means 'it is not necessary'?
options: She doesn't have to understand the language.

8.label: ТЕКСТ
8.title: The Stillsuit
8.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
8.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
8.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
8.text:
Dr Liet-Kynes, the imperial planetologist, can recognise a newcomer from a hundred metres away. Before their first trip into the desert, she shows the Atreides how to wear a stillsuit. 'With a good suit, you can survive for weeks,' she says. 'Without one, you won't be able to last a single day.'

Paul puts his suit on correctly at the first attempt, which surprises her. Nobody born off-world has ever managed to do that without help. 'Who taught you?' she asks. 'Nobody,' Paul replies. 'It just felt natural.'

Kynes looks at him for a long moment. As a child, she could read the desert like a book, and she was able to tell the weather from the colour of the sky. Now she wonders what else this strange boy can do.

words.d: a person who has just arrived

options: Paul puts on the suit correctly first time

items.q: How long can you survive without a suit?

options: a person who has just arrived

items.q: Which sentence describes a single past achievement?
options: Nobody has ever managed to do that.
Nobody has ever could do that.

items.q: Choose the correct form: 'Without a suit, you won't ___ last a day.'

9.label: ТЕКСТ
9.title: The Hunter-Seeker
9.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
9.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
9.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
9.text:
The housekeeper, Shadout Mapes, brings Lady Jessica a gift from the Fremen: a crysknife carved from a sandworm's tooth. 'If you draw it,' Mapes warns, 'it must taste blood before it is sheathed again.'

That same night, a tiny deadly machine, a hunter-seeker, floats into Paul's bedroom. It moves towards anything that moves. Paul understands immediately: if he moves, it will kill him. If he stays still, someone will come.

He stays perfectly still for what feels like hours. When Mapes opens the door, the machine turns towards her. In that instant, Paul grabs it with his bare hand and smashes it against the wall. 'If you hadn't come…' he begins. 'Then the desert would have one less mystery,' Mapes replies. From that night on, she serves Paul with absolute loyalty.

words.d: a person who manages a household
cut a shape from a material
put a knife back into its cover

items.q: What is the crysknife made from?
How does Paul destroy the hunter-seeker?

options: cut a shape from a material

items.q: Which is a correct first conditional?
options: If he moves, it will kill him.
If he moved, it will kill him.
If he will move, it kills him.

items.q: Choose the correct form: 'If he stays still, someone ___.'

10.label: ТЕКСТ
10.title: Duncan Returns
10.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
10.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
10.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
10.text:
Duncan Idaho, the finest swordsman of House Atreides, returns from the deep desert after weeks among the Fremen. When Paul was small, Duncan used to carry him on his shoulders around the castle, and they would spend hours fighting with wooden swords.

Now Paul runs to him and throws himself into his arms, just as he used to. Duncan laughs and smells of sand and spice.

The news he brings is extraordinary. 'The Harkonnens used to say there were a few thousand Fremen,' he tells the Duke. 'There are millions. They live in hidden caves called sietches, and they would die for a leader they trusted.' Leto listens carefully. For the first time since arriving on Arrakis, he sees real hope.

words.d: a person skilled at fighting with a sword
not easy to see or find

options: Among the Fremen in the desert
a person skilled with a sword

items.q: Which sentence describes a past habit?
options: Duncan is used to carry him.
Duncan used to carry him on his shoulders.

items.q: Which sentence describes a repeated past action with 'would'?
options: They would to spend hours fighting.
They would spend hours fighting with wooden swords.

11.label: ТЕКСТ
11.title: Stilgar's Gift
11.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
11.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
11.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
11.text:
Duncan brings Stilgar, leader of a Fremen tribe, into the council hall. As soon as he reaches the table, Stilgar spits on it. The officers reach for their weapons, but Duncan calmly thanks him.

On Arrakis, water is life. When a Fremen gives away the water of his body, he is showing the deepest respect. Once the Duke understands this, he thanks Stilgar too.

Stilgar explains the rules of the desert. 'If you waste water, you die. When the wind changes, the worms come.' Before he leaves, he asks the Duke to let Duncan join his people. Leto agrees immediately. As the doors close behind Stilgar, Thufir murmurs that the Fremen are the most dangerous people he has ever met. 'Good,' says the Duke. 'Then let's make sure they are on our side.'

words.d: force liquid out of your mouth

items.q: Why does Stilgar spit on the table?

options: If you waste water, you die.
If you wasted water, you would die.
If you waste water, you would have died.
When the wind changed, the worms will come.
When the wind changes, the worms come.
When the wind will change, the worms come.

13.label: ТЕКСТ
13.title: The Spice Harvester
13.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
13.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
13.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
13.text:
The ornithopters rise over the desert. Below them, a gigantic harvester is crawling across the sand. Kynes explains how it works: the spice is sucked up from the surface, it is processed inside the machine, and it is collected by carriers.

'Why is it done so quickly?' Paul asks. 'Because every harvester is eventually found,' Kynes replies. 'The vibration is felt by the worms for kilometres.'

The Duke watches in silence. The machine was built by the Harkonnens decades ago, and it has been repaired so many times that hardly any original parts remain. 'How much spice was harvested last year?' he asks. Kynes tells him the number. It is far lower than the figure the Harkonnens reported to the Emperor.

words.d: a machine that collects crops or resources

items.q: Why is the spice harvested quickly?
What does the Duke learn about the Harkonnens' report?

options: The spice sucks up the machine.
The machine sucks up the spice.
The spice is sucked up from the surface.

items.q: Choose the correct passive: 'The machine ___ by the Harkonnens.'

14.label: ТЕКСТ
14.title: The Worm
14.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
14.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
14.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
14.text:
A sandworm approaches the harvester, and the carrier that should lift the machine to safety does not arrive. It has broken down. The Duke, who could simply fly away, orders every ornithopter to land and rescue the workers.

The men who run across the sand are terrified. Paul, whose eyes are fixed on the dunes, sees the ground rising like a wave. Then the worm appears: a creature that is larger than a building, with a mouth that could swallow the harvester whole.

The last ornithopter takes off just as the worm closes its jaws. The harvester disappears forever. The workers who were saved that day will never forget the Duke who risked his life for them, and neither will the Fremen who were watching from the rocks.

options: Ornithopters to land and rescue the workers

items.q: Who was watching from the rocks?
Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'the carrier ___ should lift the machine'
Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'Paul, ___ eyes are fixed on the dunes'

15.label: ТЕКСТ
15.title: Counting the Cost
15.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
15.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
15.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
15.text:
In the evening the palace counts its losses. The harvester is gone, and so is all the spice inside it. There isn't much money left in the treasury. The Harkonnens left very few working machines and a great many debts.

Kynes explains how much water would be needed to change the planet. 'Enough to fill a small sea,' she says. 'It would take a few centuries, but it is possible.'

The Duke has too little equipment and not enough time. Several of his advisers believe the planet cannot be made profitable. But Leto has learned something today that no amount of spice could buy: the respect of the people who saw him save the workers. 'We have few machines,' he says, 'but we have a little hope. For now, that will have to be enough.'

words.d: tools and machines needed for a purpose

items.q: What did the Harkonnens leave behind?
How long would changing the planet take?
Choose the correct quantifier: 'There isn't ___ money left.'
Choose the correct quantifier: 'The Harkonnens left very ___ machines.'

16.label: ТЕКСТ
16.title: Desert Power
16.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
16.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
16.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
16.text:
Late at night, Paul and his father stand by a window overlooking the glowing desert. 'On Caladan, we relied on sea power and air power,' Leto says. 'Here, we need desert power. We need the Fremen.'

Paul asks what he would do if the Fremen refused. 'If they refused, I would ask again,' the Duke replies. 'If I were in their position, I wouldn't trust a duke either.'

Then Leto says something Paul will remember for the rest of his life. 'If anything happened to me, I would want you to be careful whom you trust. Not everyone in this palace is our friend.' Paul wants to ask more, but his father has already turned back to the window, watching the distant lights of the spice fields.

words.d: have a view of from above

What would Leto do if the Fremen refused?
What does Leto warn Paul about?
options: Not everyone in the palace is a friend

options: If I were in their position, I wouldn't trust a duke.
If I am in their position, I wouldn't trust a duke.
If I were in their position, I won't trust a duke.

17.label: ТЕКСТ
17.title: Rumours
17.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
17.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
17.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
17.text:
Worrying news keeps reaching the palace. The Fremen told Duncan that they had seen soldiers in grey uniforms in the desert. Kynes said that the Harkonnens had not taken all their ships away yet.

Thufir reported that his spy on Giedi Prime had gone silent. He said he would send another, but that it would take weeks. Gurney said that the smugglers in the city were nervous and that some of them were leaving.

The Duke listened to all of it without interrupting. Then he said that they would double the guards and that nobody would leave the palace without permission. Jessica told him that she had a bad feeling. Leto took her hand and said that he had one too.

words.d: a story that may not be true
a person who moves goods illegally

options: a person who moves goods illegally

items.q: Report Kynes's words 'The Harkonnens haven't taken their ships':
options: Kynes said the Harkonnens haven't took their ships.
Kynes said the Harkonnens hadn't taken their ships.
Kynes said I hadn't taken their ships.

items.q: Report Thufir's words 'I will send another':
options: He said he will sent another.
He said I would send another.
He said he would send another.

19.label: ТЕКСТ
19.title: The Night Without Shields
19.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
19.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
19.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
19.text:
Deep in the night, the lights go out and the great shield protecting the city disappears. The guards are not at their posts. Someone must have switched off the defences from the inside.

It can't have been a Harkonnen agent, Thufir thinks, because no outsider knows the codes. It must have been one of us. It might have been anyone with access to the generator room.

On the horizon, the lights of hundreds of ships are approaching. The Harkonnens must have been waiting for this moment for months. Thufir runs towards the Duke's rooms, but the corridors are silent and the doors are open. He feels cold. The traitor could still be inside the palace, and he could be anywhere.

words.d: a place where a guard stands

items.q: Why does Thufir think it wasn't an outsider?
What does Thufir see on the horizon?
Which sentence expresses certainty about the past?
options: Someone must to have switched them off.
Someone must switched off the defences.
Someone must have switched off the defences.
It can't have been a Harkonnen agent.
It can't been a Harkonnen agent.
It mustn't be a Harkonnen agent yesterday.

20.label: ТЕКСТ
20.title: Yueh's Confession
20.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
20.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
20.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
20.text:
You manage to hide in a ventilation shaft and crawl to Dr Yueh's laboratory. His confession lies on the desk. The Harkonnens had taken his wife Wanna and promised to release her if he agreed to switch off the shield.

Yueh admits to betraying the Duke, but he refuses to accept the Baron's lies. He knew Wanna was probably dead. He decided to take revenge in his own way: he hid a poison tooth in the Duke's mouth, hoping that Leto would manage to kill the Baron before dying.

At the end of the letter, Yueh asks the reader to forgive him. 'I regret doing this,' he writes, 'but I will never regret trying to save her.' You fold the letter and keep crawling. You have to reach Gurney before dawn.

words.d: a passage for air in a building

items.q: Why did Yueh betray the Duke?
options: The Harkonnens had taken his wife

items.q: What did Yueh hide in the Duke's mouth?
Who do you need to reach before dawn?
Choose the correct form: 'Yueh admits to ___ the Duke.'
Choose the correct form: 'He refuses ___ the Baron's lies.'

21.label: ТЕКСТ
21.title: The Fall
21.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
21.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
21.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
21.text:
By the time you and Gurney reached the surface, it was already over. The palace had been burning for hours, and the streets were full of Harkonnen soldiers and grey Sardaukar.

The Atreides guards who had managed to escape were hiding in the cellars. They told you what had happened. The Duke had been captured before the attack even started. Thufir had died defending the gates. Nobody had seen Paul or Jessica since midnight.

Gurney sat down on a broken step and said nothing for a long time. He had served House Atreides since he was a boy, and he had never imagined that it could fall in a single night. Finally he stood up. 'We find Duncan,' he said. 'And then we find the boy.'

words.d: the outside or top of something

items.q: What was happening when they reached the surface?
What had happened to the Duke?
Which sentence uses the past perfect correctly?
options: The Duke was captured after the attack had start.
The Duke had been captured before the attack started.
The Duke has been captured before the attack started.

items.q: Choose the correct form: 'Nobody ___ Paul since midnight.'

22.label: ТЕКСТ
22.title: The Interrogation
22.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
22.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
22.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
22.text:
A Harkonnen patrol catches you on the way to Duncan. The officer questions you for hours. He asks where Paul is hiding. He asks whether the witch has escaped into the desert, and who else from the household is still alive.

You say nothing, or you answer in ways that give nothing away. The officer tells his men to tie your hands more tightly. He orders them not to give you any water until you talk.

In the middle of the night, someone cuts the ropes of your tent. It is Duncan. He asks you if you can walk, and tells you to stay silent and follow him. Outside, two guards are lying on the sand. 'Don't ask,' Duncan whispers, and he leads you into the darkness of the desert.

words.d: a group of soldiers checking an area

items.q: What does the officer want to know?

options: He asked where Paul was hiding.
He asked where was Paul hiding.
He asked where Paul is hiding yesterday.
He ordered them don't give you water.
He ordered them to not giving you water.
He ordered them not to give you water.

23.label: ТЕКСТ
23.title: The Desert Station
23.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
23.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
23.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
23.text:
Duncan leads you to Kynes's old station, hidden among the rocks. You have been waiting all day, and the heat has been getting worse since noon. Towards evening, a Harkonnen ornithopter appears. To your astonishment, Paul and Jessica climb out of it.

Jessica used the Voice to force the guards to free them. Since then, they have been flying across the desert, and they have been hiding from patrols for almost two days.

Paul looks different. He has been thinking about his father all the time, and he has hardly spoken. 'How long have you been waiting here?' he asks Duncan. 'Long enough to worry,' Duncan answers, and he embraces the boy.

words.d: a Bene Gesserit power to control people by speaking

items.q: Who climbs out of the ornithopter?
Which sentence uses the present perfect continuous?
options: They are hiding since two days.
They have hiding for two days.
They have been hiding for two days.
How long you have been waiting?

25.label: ТЕКСТ
25.title: Through the Storm
25.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
25.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
25.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
25.text:
That evening at the station, Paul and Jessica describe their escape. When the Harkonnens chased them, Jessica flew straight into a sandstorm. The wings creaked, sand beat against the glass, and the machine shook violently.

'I wish we hadn't had to do it,' Jessica says quietly. 'If only there had been another way.' Paul remembers whispering the litany against fear again and again.

Now he sits by the fire, staring at the flames. 'I wish my father were here,' he says. 'I wish I had told him how much I admired him.' Jessica takes his hand. She wishes she could tell him everything would be all right, but she has promised herself never to lie to her son.

words.d: make a high sound when moving
look at something for a long time

items.q: How did they escape the Harkonnens?

options: Not telling his father he admired him
Never to lie to her son
make a high sound when moving

items.q: Which sentence expresses a regret about the past?
options: I wish I will tell him.
I wish I told him yesterday.
I wish I had told him.

items.q: Which sentence expresses a wish about the present?
options: I wish my father will be here.
I wish my father were here.

26.label: ТЕКСТ
26.title: The Vision
26.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
26.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
26.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
26.text:
Night at the station. Paul tells his mother what he saw in the tent after the storm, when the spice dust opened his mind. He saw Fremen armies under black-and-green banners, a holy war fought in his name, and a girl with blue eyes.

Although he fears this future, he understands that it may be impossible to avoid. 'I don't want it,' he says. 'However, every path I see leads there.'

Jessica listens in silence. Despite her training, she is frightened. Whereas other mothers dream of their sons becoming great, she has always feared exactly this. Even though she raised him to be strong, she never wanted him to carry the weight of a whole universe.

words.d: something seen in a dream or the mind

options: A holy war in his name

27.label: ТЕКСТ
27.title: Duncan's Last Stand
27.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
27.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
27.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
27.text:
The Sardaukar find the station. Duncan orders Paul, Jessica and you to run to the ornithopter while he stays behind in a narrow corridor with his sword.

He holds the door far longer than anyone thought possible. If he hadn't stayed, none of you would have reached the machine. If the Sardaukar had come a minute earlier, the ornithopter would never have taken off.

Through the window you see Duncan fall, surrounded by grey uniforms. Paul presses his hand against the glass. 'If I had been stronger, he wouldn't have died,' he says. Jessica shakes her head. 'If you had stayed, he would have died for nothing.' Paul says nothing for the rest of the flight.

28.label: ТЕКСТ
28.title: Kynes's Last Song
28.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
28.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
28.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
28.text:
The ornithopter lands at the edge of the dunes: flying further is too dangerous. From the top of a dune, you see Kynes below. She stayed behind to hold off the pursuit, and the Sardaukar have surrounded her.

They force her to kneel. But Kynes does not let them see fear. She makes them wait while she sings a Fremen song, and she lets her voice carry across the sand.

Then she strikes the sand with her hand, again and again, in a rhythm that the Sardaukar don't understand. Within minutes, a worm rises beneath them. Kynes allowed the desert to finish her last battle. Paul watches, and he makes himself remember every second.

words.d: a regular repeated pattern of sounds

29.label: ТЕКСТ
29.title: The Night March
29.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
29.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
29.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
29.text:
You, Paul and Jessica set out on foot across the deep desert. Walking by day is impossible, so you walk at night with an uneven step that won't attract a worm.

By dawn tomorrow, you will have covered thirty kilometres. This time next week, you will be crossing the open sand where no Harkonnen patrol dares to go. By the end of the month, Paul calculates, you will have reached the rocks where the Fremen live, if the water lasts.

During the day, you hide under a tent made from stillsuit fabric. Jessica draws the route on a scrap of paper. 'We'll be walking for many nights,' she says. 'By the time we arrive, we will have learned the desert, or it will have killed us.'

31.label: ТЕКСТ
31.title: The Fremen
31.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
31.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
31.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
31.text:
Stilgar and his warriors surround you on the sand. Some of them want to take your water and leave you to die; outsiders slow everyone down. But Stilgar remembers the Duke who put his own life at risk to save the workers.

He decides to take the fugitives in. 'We will not turn our backs on the Duke's son,' he says. One warrior, Jamis, refuses to back down. He argues that the strangers will give the sietch away to the Harkonnens.

Stilgar cuts him off. 'I have made my decision.' The Fremen set off across the dunes at a pace that you can barely keep up with. You don't know where they are taking you, but for the first time in days, you feel safe.

32.label: ТЕКСТ
32.title: Chani
32.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
32.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
32.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
32.text:
The Fremen stop for the night in a cave beneath the rocks. Chani brings you water and silently watches you drink. She has such bright blue eyes that Paul stops breathing for a moment: it is the girl from his dreams.

Paul tries to talk to her, but she answers briefly and sharply. 'You are too soft for the desert,' she says. 'Your hands are so clean that they have never worked.'

Jamis says loudly that the outsiders are too weak to survive and not strong enough to deserve water. Chani doesn't defend them, but she doesn't agree with him either. Later, when everyone is asleep, she leaves an extra water bottle beside Paul. It is such a small gesture, yet it means everything.

33.label: ТЕКСТ
33.title: The Challenge
33.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
33.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
33.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
33.text:
At dawn, Jamis challenges Paul to a duel. Under Fremen law, refusing is impossible. The Fremen form a circle on the sand. Jamis is stronger and more experienced, but Paul has trained with Gurney and Duncan all his life.

The duel is short. Paul wins, and for the first time in his life, he kills a man. Afterwards, he shakes. 'I should have disarmed him,' he whispers. 'I could have let him live.' Jessica tells him that he couldn't have done anything else: Fremen law demanded a death.

Stilgar disagrees with Paul in a different way. 'You shouldn't have played with him before winning,' he says. 'A Fremen kills quickly, out of respect.' Then he gives Paul Jamis's water and a new name: Usul.

34.label: ТЕКСТ
34.title: The Worm Rider
34.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
34.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
34.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
34.text:
At dawn, the Fremen lead you to the top of a rock. Far below, a huge worm is moving through the desert, and a man is standing on its back. He holds on to the scales with hooks and steers the worm like a ship.

'It's incredible, isn't it?' Chani says. Paul can't take his eyes off the rider. 'Do you know how long it takes to learn?' he asks. 'Years,' Stilgar answers. 'You want to try, don't you?'

Paul nods. Stilgar smiles for the first time. 'Could you tell me whether you are afraid?' he asks. 'Yes,' Paul admits. 'Good,' says Stilgar. 'The desert doesn't trust anyone who isn't.'

words.d: a small hard plate on an animal's skin

items.q: How long does it take to learn?

options: Could you tell me whether are you afraid?
Could you tell me are you afraid?
Could you tell me whether you are afraid?
